data.name: Weakening Claws Stain
data.description: You take a -2 penalty on Disable Device checks, Sleight of Hand checks, and attacks with manufactured weapons. Your spells with somatic or emotion (Pathfinder RPG Occult Adventures 144) components have a failure chance of 5%%. If you have a spell failure chance from other sources, add the chances together.
